reuse: One uninterrupted role06 runtime tape; no extra pose writer or extra rendering take. Use R4-02 existing support/input fixtures and corrected3.75m view envelope.
required_fields: actual rig.global_transform and all final modifier-processed bone globals keyed by actual bone name
actual imported vertex arrays, skin inverse binds and bind-bone names, live morph and shader offsets
actual body transform, collision capsule radius/height/offset, is_on_floor, floor normal and actual slide collider/point/normal
per-side original planted anchor world position, support state, release age and local+world skin positions
native spring hit length and actual review-camera transform
full recorded light/render controls plus actual ambient and SSAO numeric parameters

sole_selector.space: Actual imported rest vertex and named bind influences
sole_selector.rule: POSITION.y<.30m and sum(WEIGHT for bind name starts foot/toe and ends .L/.R)>.5
sole_selector.requirement: Log actual selected counts and exact selected index/material/bind-name manifest; a count mismatch is evidence to investigate, not silently discarded.

metrics: Minimum signed sole distance to actual contact plane dot(vertex-contact_point,normal), per side; report penetration and clearance separately.
Projected source/native skin extrema against original framebuffer feet; preserve camera, rig and pose snapshot pins from the same rendered update.
World displacement of identical selected sole vertices while support remains planted, versus capsule displacement and fixed original anchor; do not replant to manufacture zero drift.
C0/C1 transition windows around input release/reversal, dash begin/end, jump takeoff/first contact and action release/cancel.
Compare capsule-floor contact independently from skin-floor and shadow appearance.
preserve_failures: R4-05 broader baseline/rejected-candidate motion failures remain open.

lighting_hold.do_not_vary: No shadow bias, angular softness, exposure, AO, extra fill, or material-opacity change to hide a geometric contact defect.

scope: Contract handoff only; no R4-12 execution, imported sole acceptance, new framebuffer, full lifecycle or hardware FPS claim.
